brief.meaningEn: Start a journey or task without enough information to make sound choices.
brief.meaningZh: 在掌握資料不足時便開始旅程或工作。
brief.grammar: The source is a creative variant about leaving without a map; it is not a claim about eyesight or the separate idiom go in blind.
brief.register: Travel planning and careful extensions to projects.
brief.boundaryZh: 資訊不足不等於完全不知道任何事；重點是缺少關鍵指引。
brief.misconceptionZh: 不要拿它取笑視力障礙；此處 half-blind 是對準備不足的比喻。
brief.outcomeZh: 能指出缺少甚麼資訊以及出發前可如何查證。

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 10 to 16 Part 3.docx
sources.locatorNote: DOCX table 5, row 2; page refers to the locally rendered PDF recorded in the intake summary.
sources.sentence: Without a map, we would set off half-blind.

options.en: They needed current route information before leaving.
options.zh: 他們出發前需要最新路線資訊。

options.en: They had forgotten which town they wanted.
options.zh: 他們忘了想去哪個城鎮。

options.en: The notice guaranteed clear weather.
options.zh: 通告保證天氣晴朗。

options.en: They wanted to compare the route with last year’s map only.
options.zh: 他們只想把路線與去年的地圖比較。

listening.explanationZh: 他們知道目的地，但缺少道路封閉資訊。
listening.en: A cycling group knew the town they wanted to visit but had not checked road closures. Their leader refused to set off half-blind and downloaded the current route notice first.
listening.zh: 單車隊知道想去的城鎮，卻未查道路封閉情況。領隊不願在資訊不足下出發，先下載最新路線通告。

options.en: They needed to check road closures.
options.zh: 他們需要查道路封閉情況。

options.en: They wanted a current route before riding.
options.zh: 他們想在騎車前取得最新路線。

options.en: They did not want to set off half-blind.
options.zh: 他們不想在資料不足下出發。

options.en: They were filling a gap in their travel plan.
options.zh: 他們正在補足行程資料。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都指向出發前補足關鍵資訊；金句使用來源變體。
reply.promptEn: Why did the cycling group delay its departure?

scene.promptZh: 義工知道送餐大概在哪一區，卻未收到樓宇入口及收件人名單；主管叫大家先核對。哪句最貼切？

options.en: They should not set off half-blind with only a rough area name.
options.zh: 他們不應只憑大概地區、資料不足便出發。

options.en: They already know every delivery address.
options.zh: 他們已知道所有送餐地址。

options.en: They can leave now and ask for each entrance after arriving.
options.zh: 他們可以現在出發，到埗後再逐一查問入口。

scene.explanationZh: 大概地區不足以完成送餐；先核對入口與名單。

contrast.promptZh: 哪句把此片語誤作字面視力描述？

options.en: We need a current map before starting the route.
options.zh: 開始路線前，我們需要最新地圖。

options.en: The phrase proves the riders have damaged eyesight.
options.zh: 這片語證明騎車者視力受損。

options.en: The group lacks one important piece of route information.
options.zh: 隊伍缺少一項重要路線資訊。

contrast.explanationZh: half-blind 在此形容資料不足，不能推斷任何人的視力。

dialogue.promptZh: 同伴問：「已知道活動地點，為何不立即出發？」你知道橋樑可能封閉，還未看最新通告。哪句最完整？

options.en: We would set off half-blind without the bridge notice; let us check it before choosing a route.
options.zh: 沒有橋樑通告，我們會在資料不足下出發；先查清楚再選路線吧。

options.en: The bridge may be closed today.
options.zh: 橋樑今天可能關閉。

options.en: Checking the latest notice could save a detour.
options.zh: 查看最新通告可避免繞路。

dialogue.explanationZh: 金句指出缺哪項資料及具體查證步驟。

speaking.en: Without the delivery addresses, the volunteers would set off half-blind.
speaking.zh: 沒有送餐地址，義工便會在資料不足下出發。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再說出哪項關鍵資訊缺失。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：學生正要開始替社區中心製作導覽地圖，卻只知道大樓名稱，尚未取得樓層圖和無障礙入口資料。用一至兩句英文說明為何應先查證。
writing.selfCheckZh: 把出發比喻延伸到開始工作，說明缺少哪兩項資料；不要說學生完全無知。

examples.en: The map team would set off half-blind without the floor plan and accessible-entrance details, so they should request both first.
examples.zh: 沒有樓層圖和無障礙入口資料，製圖隊便會在資訊不足下開始工作，因此應先索取兩項資料。

examples.en: Starting the guide with only a building name means setting off half-blind; the students need the floor plan and accessible-entrance details before drawing routes.
examples.zh: 只憑大樓名稱便開始導覽圖，等於在資訊不足下起步；學生畫路線前需要樓層圖和無障礙入口資料。

takeaways.en: Before the hike, they checked the weather so they would not set off half-blind.
takeaways.zh: 遠足前他們查看天氣，免得在資料不足下出發。

takeaways.en: A team may set off half-blind on a project if it lacks the basic site plan.
takeaways.zh: 團隊若缺少基本場地圖，開始項目時便可能資訊不足。

notes: AI-authored provisional proposal; independent English, Chinese, media and browser QA remain pending.

brief.meaningEn: Broken into many small, hard-to-use stretches by repeated interruptions.
brief.meaningZh: 因反覆中斷而被切成許多難以善用的小段時間。
brief.grammar: Study time is figuratively chopped into pieces; no one physically cuts time.
brief.boundaryZh: 一兩次短暫中斷未必構成零碎到無法專注的情況。
brief.misconceptionZh: 重點是可用時間被反覆切碎，不是說每一分鐘都浪費。
brief.outcomeZh: 能說明哪些中斷使一段專注時間變得零碎。

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 10 to 16 Part 3.docx
sources.locatorNote: DOCX table 6, row 4; page refers to the locally rendered PDF recorded in the intake summary.
sources.sentence: Constant interruptions leave my study time chopped into pieces.

listening.promptZh: 電話和門鈴造成甚麼影響？

options.en: They split his planned study hour into short stretches.
options.zh: 它們把原定的一小時讀書時間切成短時段。

options.en: They gave him an extra uninterrupted hour.
options.zh: 它們讓他多了一小時不受干擾的時間。

options.en: They prompted him to move to a different chapter.
options.zh: 它們促使他改讀另一章。

options.en: They made the chapter disappear.
options.zh: 它們令那一章消失。

listening.explanationZh: 反覆中斷使一整段時間變得零碎。
listening.en: Jules reserved an hour to study one chapter, but four calls and three doorbells kept interrupting him. By the end, his study hour felt chopped into pieces.
listening.zh: 朱爾斯留了一小時讀一章，但四通電話和三次門鈴反覆打斷他；到最後，這段讀書時間像被切成零碎小段。

reply.promptZh: （反覆中斷怎樣影響朱爾斯的讀書時間？）

options.en: They broke one hour into several short periods.
options.zh: 它們把一小時分成幾段短時間。

options.en: They prevented him from staying with one chapter continuously.
options.zh: 它們令他難以持續讀同一章。

options.en: His study time felt chopped into pieces.
options.zh: 他的讀書時間像被切成零碎小段。

options.en: He had to restart his focus repeatedly.
options.zh: 他要一再重新集中精神。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都描述時間被多次切斷；金句用來源比喻。
reply.promptEn: How did the interruptions affect Jules’s study time?

scene.promptZh: 設計師安排兩小時修改海報，但每十分鐘便有人叫她處理無關的小事。哪句最貼切？

options.en: Her work block was chopped into pieces by repeated requests.
options.zh: 反覆請求把她的工作時段切成零碎小段。

options.en: She completed the poster without any interruption.
options.zh: 她毫無中斷地完成海報。

options.en: The work block became shorter because the meeting began early.
options.zh: 會議提早開始，所以工作時段縮短了。

scene.explanationZh: 被切碎的是專注工作的時段；情境沒有說會議提早開始。

contrast.promptZh: 哪句屬字面切割，而非時間比喻？

options.en: The baker chopped a loaf into pieces.
options.zh: 麵包師把一條麵包切成幾塊。

options.en: Messages broke an afternoon of writing into fragments.
options.zh: 訊息把一下午的寫作切得零零碎碎。

options.en: Repeated calls made a lesson hard to finish.
options.zh: 反覆來電令一堂課難以完成。

contrast.explanationZh: 麵包真的被切開；時間則只是比喻。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友問：「為何你想把非緊急電話集中到下午四時後？」你原定一段長時間讀文獻，卻常被打斷。哪句最完整？

options.en: My reading time keeps getting chopped into pieces by calls, so I need one protected block first.
options.zh: 電話不斷把我的閱讀時間切成零碎小段，所以我先需要一段不受打擾的時間。

options.en: I need a longer block to read the article.
options.zh: 我需要一段較長時間讀文章。

options.en: The calls arrive throughout the afternoon.
options.zh: 電話在下午不斷打來。

dialogue.explanationZh: 金句指出反覆中斷及調整方法。

speaking.en: Without a quiet hour, her preparation time was chopped into pieces.
speaking.zh: 沒有安靜的一小時，她的準備時間被切成零碎小段。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再說出時間怎樣被反覆打斷。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：急救義工只有一段早上時間練習操作，卻每隔幾分鐘便被叫去做非緊急文書工作。協調員決定把文書工作集中到午飯後。用一至兩句英文解釋安排。
writing.selfCheckZh: 指出練習時間被切碎，以及集中文書工作的作用。

examples.en: The volunteers’ practice time was chopped into pieces by small admin requests, so paperwork was moved to the afternoon.
examples.zh: 零碎文書請求把義工練習時間切成小段，因此文書工作改到下午處理。

examples.en: Their morning training kept being chopped into pieces; grouping non-urgent paperwork after lunch gave them a longer practice block.
examples.zh: 早上的訓練不斷被切得零零碎碎；午飯後集中處理非緊急文書，便可留一段較長的練習時間。

takeaways.en: Repeated doorbells left the planning hour chopped into pieces.
takeaways.zh: 反覆響起的門鈴把策劃時間切成零碎小段。

takeaways.en: A protected work block can prevent the afternoon from being chopped into pieces.
takeaways.zh: 一段不受打擾的工作時間可避免下午被切得零零碎碎。

notes: AI-authored provisional proposal; independent English, Chinese, media and browser QA remain pending.

brief.meaningEn: Feel overwhelmed by repeated daily demands, with no room to pause or choose.
brief.meaningZh: 被反覆的日常要求壓得喘不過氣，感到沒有停頓或選擇空間。
brief.grammar: The person is figuratively swallowed whole by routine; this differs from another image in which an activity swallows time.
brief.boundaryZh: 這是主觀感受，不是說每天所有工作都毫無價值。
brief.misconceptionZh: whole 加強被全面淹沒的感受，不能省成只是一項小麻煩。
brief.outcomeZh: 能描述反覆事務怎樣令人感到被淹沒，以及可能留下休息空間。

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 10 to 16 Part 3.docx
sources.locatorNote: DOCX table 8, row 11; page refers to the locally rendered PDF recorded in the intake summary.
sources.sentence: Without a break, people can feel swallowed whole by routine.

listening.promptZh: 莉娜的話表達甚麼感受？

options.en: Repeated demands left her feeling overwhelmed.
options.zh: 反覆的要求令她感到不勝負荷。

options.en: She had enjoyed a long break every day.
options.zh: 她每天都享受長時間休息。

options.en: She thought all household tasks were pointless.
options.zh: 她認為所有家務都毫無意義。

options.en: One unusually busy day changed her entire schedule.
options.zh: 只有一天特別忙，便改變了她整個日程。

listening.explanationZh: 她談的是數星期沒有停頓的反覆要求，不是單一忙碌日，也沒有否定家務的價值。
listening.en: For weeks, Leena went from early shifts to household chores without a pause. She told her friend she felt swallowed whole by routine and missed having time to think.
listening.zh: 數星期來，莉娜從早班工作接着做家務，幾乎沒有停頓。她對朋友說，自己感到被日常事務完全吞沒，連思考的時間也沒有。

reply.promptZh: （莉娜怎樣形容數星期的工作與家務？）

options.en: She felt overwhelmed by a repeating pattern.
options.zh: 她感到被重複的安排壓倒。

options.en: She had little space to pause or reflect.
options.zh: 她幾乎沒有停頓或反思的空間。

options.en: She felt swallowed whole by routine.
options.zh: 她感到被日常事務完全吞沒。

options.en: Her days seemed to leave no time for herself.
options.zh: 她的日子似乎沒有留下屬於自己的時間。

reply.explanationZh: 四句均描述被反覆事務壓得喘不過氣。
reply.promptEn: How did Leena describe weeks of work and chores?

scene.promptZh: 學生每天放學後連續補習、做家務、完成作業，整週沒有休息；他說自己快要沒有喘息空間。哪句最貼切？

options.en: He feels swallowed whole by routine.
options.zh: 他感到被日常事務完全吞沒。

options.en: He has stopped doing all his work.
options.zh: 他已停止所有工作。

options.en: He was only tired after one unusually busy afternoon.
options.zh: 他只是經歷一個特別忙碌的下午後感到疲倦。

scene.explanationZh: 多項日常要求接連而來，令他覺得被壓倒。

contrast.promptZh: 哪句更接近「一項工作耗掉很多時間」，而非本課「人被日常事務淹沒」？

options.en: She feels trapped in a repetitive schedule.
options.zh: 她感到被重複日程困住。

options.en: Editing one video swallowed the whole afternoon.
options.zh: 剪輯一段影片耗掉了整個下午。

options.en: He needs a pause from his repeated duties.
options.zh: 他需要從反覆職責中休息。

contrast.explanationZh: 這句的主語是單一工作，受影響的是下午時間，與本課的人被 routine 吞沒不同。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友說：「每天只剩工作和家務，我連坐下來想想都沒有時間。」你想提議一段真正休息時間。哪句最完整？

options.en: You sound swallowed whole by routine; could we protect one free evening this week?
options.zh: 你聽起來像被日常事務完全吞沒；我們能否在本週留一晚真正休息？

options.en: You have had too much to do lately.
options.zh: 你最近要做的事太多。

options.en: A free evening might help you pause.
options.zh: 一晚空閒或許能讓你停一停。

dialogue.explanationZh: 金句回應感受並提出具體休息安排。

speaking.en: After months without a break, he felt swallowed whole by routine.
speaking.zh: 幾個月沒有休息後，他感到被日常事務完全吞沒。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再說出反覆事務帶來甚麼感受。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：一名教師每天在課後連續處理電郵、評分及會議安排，已很久沒時間準備喜愛的讀書活動；學校讓各科共用一段不安排會議的備課時間。用一至兩句英文說明安排。
writing.selfCheckZh: 指出被反覆事務淹沒的感受和備課時段的作用；不要說電郵、評分毫無價值。

examples.en: The teacher felt swallowed whole by routine after weeks of emails and marking; a meeting-free block gave her time to plan reading activities.
examples.zh: 數星期不斷處理電郵和評分後，教師感到被日常事務完全吞沒；不安排會議的時段讓她策劃閱讀活動。

examples.en: Without time to plan lessons she enjoyed, she felt swallowed whole by daily demands; the new planning block gave her room to think.
examples.zh: 沒有時間策劃喜愛的課堂活動，她感到被日常要求完全吞沒；新增的備課時段給她思考空間。

glossary.zh: 數星期的電郵和評分工作

takeaways.en: A worker can feel swallowed whole by routine while still valuing the work itself.
takeaways.zh: 即使仍重視工作本身，員工也可能感到被日常事務完全吞沒。

takeaways.en: A short protected break helped her stop feeling swallowed whole by routine.
takeaways.zh: 一段受保障的短暫休息讓她不再覺得被日常事務完全吞沒。

notes: AI-authored provisional proposal; independent English, Chinese, media and browser QA remain pending.

brief.meaningEn: A chart or model represents a place or situation but cannot contain every detail of the real thing.
brief.meaningZh: 圖表或模型只代表某地或某情況，無法涵蓋現實的所有細節。
brief.grammar: Use this phrase after a noun such as chart or model; it is a map–territory metaphor, not a free-standing label.
brief.register: Planning, data interpretation and model limitations.
brief.boundaryZh: 圖表可以有用；指出限制不等於說它錯誤或全無價值。
brief.misconceptionZh: territory 指實際情況，不一定是字面的土地。
brief.outcomeZh: 能指出圖表遺漏了哪項現場資訊。

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 10 to 16 Part 3.docx
sources.locatorNote: DOCX table 15, row 16; page refers to the locally rendered PDF recorded in the intake summary.
sources.sentence: A chart is useful, but it is not the territory itself.

options.en: Today’s street conditions might differ from the chart.
options.zh: 今天的街道情況可能與圖表不同。

options.en: The chart included every blocked drain today.
options.zh: 圖表已列出今天每條堵塞的排水渠。

options.en: The chart had no useful information at all.
options.zh: 圖表完全沒有有用資訊。

options.en: The team needed last year’s rainfall totals before deciding.
options.zh: 團隊在決定前需要去年的降雨總量。

listening.explanationZh: 圖表提供參考，現場情況仍須核對。
listening.en: A flood chart showed last year’s safe streets, but a new drain was blocked today. The planner said the chart was useful, but not the territory itself, and sent a team to inspect the streets.
listening.zh: 水浸圖表顯示去年安全的街道，但今天一條新排水渠堵塞了。規劃員說圖表有用，卻並非實際情況本身，於是派隊到街上視察。

options.en: The chart could miss a recent change.
options.zh: 圖表可能漏掉近期變化。

options.en: A useful chart still needs a present-day check.
options.zh: 有用的圖表仍須配合今天的核查。

options.en: The chart was useful but not the territory itself.
options.zh: 圖表有用，但並非實際情況本身。

options.en: The blocked drain might alter the route.
options.zh: 堵塞的排水渠可能改變路線。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都承認圖表有用而現況可能不同。
reply.promptEn: Why did the planner inspect the streets?

scene.promptZh: 導遊看到舊路線圖，卻得知小徑剛因維修關閉。哪句最貼切？

options.en: The route map is helpful, but not the territory itself.
options.zh: 路線圖有幫助，卻並非實際情況本身。

options.en: The map proves the path is open today.
options.zh: 地圖證明小徑今天開放。

options.en: The guide should follow the old map without checking the new closure.
options.zh: 導遊應依舊地圖走，不用查最新封閉通告。

scene.explanationZh: 地圖須與最新現場通告核對。

contrast.promptZh: 哪句把這個比喻誤作字面土地爭議？

options.en: A model may omit a recent change.
options.zh: 模型可能漏掉近期變化。

options.en: The phrase means the chart is not a legal owner of land.
options.zh: 這片語指圖表不是土地的法律業主。

options.en: Field observations can correct an old diagram.
options.zh: 實地觀察可修正舊圖。

contrast.explanationZh: 此處 territory 比喻完整現實，並非土地擁有權。

dialogue.promptZh: 同事問：「交通圖顯示巴士準時，何必查看站頭？」你知道施工可能改了站位。哪句最完整？

options.en: The chart is useful but not the territory itself; let us check the stop after the roadworks.
options.zh: 圖表有用，但並非實際情況本身；道路工程後我們先核對站位。

options.en: Roadworks may have moved the stop.
options.zh: 工程可能令站位改變。

options.en: We can check the stop before leaving.
options.zh: 出發前我們可以核對站位。

dialogue.explanationZh: 金句保留圖表用途，並指出具體核查事項。

speaking.en: The diagram is useful, but not the territory itself after the roadworks.
speaking.zh: 工程後圖示仍有用，但並非實際情況本身。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再說出圖示可能遺漏甚麼。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：市民依照舊交通應用程式地圖找車站，卻發現路口施工後站位已改。用一至兩句英文建議服務隊怎樣處理。
writing.selfCheckZh: 說明地圖只是參考，並提出核對最新站位；不要說應用程式完全無用。

examples.en: The app map is helpful but not the territory itself; the team should verify the stop after the roadworks.
examples.zh: 應用程式地圖有幫助，卻並非實際情況本身；團隊應在工程後核對站位。

examples.en: A map on a screen is not the territory itself when the junction has changed, so staff should check the current stop sign.
examples.zh: 路口改變後，螢幕上的地圖並非實際情況本身，所以職員應查看現時的站牌。

takeaways.en: A weather model is useful, but not the territory itself when local conditions change.
takeaways.zh: 天氣模型有用，但當地情況改變時，它並非實際情況本身。

takeaways.en: A visitor used the floor plan as a guide, knowing it was not the territory itself.
takeaways.zh: 訪客以樓層圖作指引，同時明白它並非實際情況本身。

notes: AI-authored provisional proposal; independent English, Chinese, media and browser QA remain pending.

lessons.titleEn: convenience has started to replace capability
lessons.titleZh: 方便逐漸取代實際能力

brief.meaningEn: Ease is beginning to displace people’s ability to perform or check a task themselves.
brief.meaningZh: 方便開始使人逐漸失去親自完成或核查工作的能力。
brief.grammar: A qualified observation about a trend, not a claim that every convenient tool is bad.
brief.register: Workplace skills and reliance on tools.
brief.boundaryZh: 要有技能或核查能力減弱的證據，不能僅因使用工具便作此判斷。
brief.misconceptionZh: started to 表示趨勢初現，不等於能力已完全消失。
brief.outcomeZh: 能說出哪項能力正在被哪種便利取代，以及可如何保留能力。

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 10 to 16 Part 3.docx
sources.locatorNote: DOCX table 27, row 4; page refers to the locally rendered PDF recorded in the intake summary.
sources.sentence: In some offices, convenience has started to replace capability.
sources.expression: convenience has started to replace capability

options.en: Staff were losing the habit of checking addresses themselves.
options.zh: 職員逐漸失去自行核對地址的習慣。

options.en: Every automatic address was accurate.
options.zh: 每個自動地址都準確。

options.en: The office had stopped sending parcels.
options.zh: 辦公室已停止寄包裹。

options.en: Staff had never learned to use the postal system.
options.zh: 職員從未學過使用郵政系統。

listening.explanationZh: 問題在於過度依賴自動填寫後缺乏核查能力。
listening.en: At one office, staff used automatic address filling for every parcel. When several entries were wrong, few remembered how to check the postal codes. A supervisor worried that convenience has started to replace capability.
listening.zh: 一間辦公室每件包裹都使用自動填寫地址。數項資料出錯時，少有職員記得如何核對郵區號碼。主管擔心方便逐漸取代了實際能力。

options.en: Automatic filling was becoming a substitute for checking.
options.zh: 自動填寫逐漸取代人手核查。

options.en: Some staff struggled to verify wrong entries.
options.zh: 部分職員難以核對錯誤資料。

options.en: Convenience has started to replace capability.
options.zh: 方便逐漸取代實際能力。

options.en: Staff might lose an important checking skill.
options.zh: 職員可能逐漸失去一項重要核查技能。

reply.explanationZh: 四句均指出便利可能侵蝕核查能力。
reply.promptEn: What concern did the supervisor raise?

scene.promptZh: 咖啡店每杯飲品都靠程式設定份量，機器故障時，員工不知如何量取基本材料。哪句最貼切？

options.en: Here, convenience has started to replace capability.
options.zh: 在這裏，方便逐漸取代了實際能力。

options.en: A second machine would remove any need to learn manual measuring.
options.zh: 添置第二部機器便毋須學習人手量取份量。

options.en: Every convenient machine is harmful.
options.zh: 每部方便的機器都有害。

scene.explanationZh: 無法手動量取是能力減弱的具體證據。

contrast.promptZh: 哪句避免把此批評說得過於絕對？

options.en: The tool is convenient, but staff should still know how to verify its output.
options.zh: 工具方便，但職員仍應懂得核查結果。

options.en: Any use of software destroys every worker’s skills.
options.zh: 只要使用軟件，所有員工的技能都會消失。

options.en: Automatic filling can never make a mistake.
options.zh: 自動填寫絕不會出錯。

contrast.explanationZh: 此批評關乎保留核查能力，不是否定所有工具。

dialogue.promptZh: 同事問：「既然系統會自動填表，為何還要教新人查資料？」你發現系統偶爾把門牌寫錯。哪句最完整？

options.en: Convenience has started to replace capability here; teach the address check so staff can catch those errors.
options.zh: 這裏的方便開始取代實際能力；教職員核對地址，才能發現那些錯誤。

options.en: The system sometimes writes the number wrongly.
options.zh: 系統有時寫錯門牌號碼。

options.en: New staff should learn the check.
options.zh: 新職員應學會核查。

dialogue.explanationZh: 金句指出趨勢及保留能力的具體做法。

speaking.en: At the office, convenience has started to replace capability in basic address checks.
speaking.zh: 在那間辦公室，方便開始取代基本地址核查能力。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再說出哪項能力可能流失。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：小型餐廳用程式自動計算食材份量；程式離線時，廚師發現新人無法量取常用份量。經理安排手動量取練習。用一至兩句英文說明原因。
writing.selfCheckZh: 指出程式帶來方便，也指出手動量取能力及練習需要；不要一概否定程式。

examples.en: The offline app exposed a gap: convenience has started to replace capability among new cooks, who need portion-measuring practice.
examples.zh: 程式離線暴露了一項缺口：方便開始取代新廚師的實際能力，他們需要練習量取份量。

examples.en: The app saves time, but convenience has started to replace capability in portion checks, so the manager added manual practice.
examples.zh: 程式節省時間，但在核對份量方面，方便逐漸取代實際能力，所以經理加上手動練習。

takeaways.en: At the workshop, convenience has started to replace capability in simple repairs.
takeaways.zh: 在工作坊，方便開始取代簡單維修的實際能力。

takeaways.en: If no one can check the output, convenience has started to replace capability.
takeaways.zh: 如果沒有人能核查結果，方便便可能開始取代實際能力。

notes: AI-authored provisional proposal; independent English, Chinese, media and browser QA remain pending.

lessons.titleEn: a practical tool rather than just a toy
lessons.titleZh: 不只是玩具，也是實用工具

target.pattern: \ba practical tool rather than just a toy\b

brief.meaningEn: Useful for a real task as well as possible entertainment.
brief.meaningZh: 除了可能用來娛樂，也能完成實際工作。
brief.grammar: The contrast describes a device’s use; it does not claim all play is worthless.
brief.boundaryZh: 要指出具體實用工作，不能只把電子裝置稱為工具而沒有例子。
brief.misconceptionZh: rather than just a toy 不等於完全不能用來玩。
brief.outcomeZh: 能舉出一項實際用途，解釋為何物件不只是玩具。

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 10 to 16 Part 3.docx
sources.locatorNote: DOCX table 39, row 2; page refers to the locally rendered PDF recorded in the intake summary.
sources.sentence: A basic phone can be a practical tool rather than just a toy.
sources.expression: a practical tool rather than just a toy

listening.promptZh: 手機的實際用途是甚麼？

options.en: It helped her contact the harbour and check the tide.
options.zh: 它讓她聯絡港口和查看潮汐。

options.en: It made the sea completely safe.
options.zh: 它令海面絕對安全。

options.en: It replaced the fishing boat.
options.zh: 它取代了漁船。

options.en: It was only for games on the trip.
options.zh: 它在旅途中只用來玩遊戲。

listening.explanationZh: 聯絡港口和查潮汐都是實際用途。
listening.en: Nadia took a simple phone on her fishing trips. It let her call the harbour and check the tide before returning. For her, it was a practical tool rather than just a toy.
listening.zh: 娜迪亞出海捕魚時帶着一部簡單手機；她可以聯絡港口，回航前查看潮汐。對她而言，它不只是玩具，也是實用工具。

options.en: It helped with practical tasks at sea.
options.zh: 它有助她在海上處理實際事情。

options.en: It offered more than amusement.
options.zh: 它的用途不止娛樂。

options.en: It was a practical tool rather than just a toy.
options.zh: 它不只是玩具，也是實用工具。

options.en: It helped her prepare for the return trip.
options.zh: 它有助她準備回航。

reply.explanationZh: 四句均指出手機有實際用途。
reply.promptEn: How did Nadia view her phone?

scene.promptZh: 圖書館學生用平板掃描還書條碼、檢查借閱紀錄，休息時也可玩遊戲。哪句最貼切？

options.en: The tablet is a practical tool rather than just a toy.
options.zh: 平板不只是玩具，也是實用工具。

options.en: The tablet matters mainly because games keep volunteers occupied between scans.
options.zh: 平板主要是讓義工在掃描工作之間玩遊戲，才有價值。

options.en: Scanning a barcode has no practical use.
options.zh: 掃描條碼沒有實際用途。

scene.explanationZh: 掃描還書和查紀錄是具體實用用途。

contrast.promptZh: 哪句誤解了 just 一字？

options.en: The device may entertain and still support work.
options.zh: 裝置可以娛樂，也能支援工作。

options.en: It means the device must never be used for play.
options.zh: 這表示裝置絕對不能用來玩。

options.en: The phrase denies that entertainment is its only role.
options.zh: 這片語否定娛樂是它唯一用途。

contrast.explanationZh: just 限制的是「只是玩具」，並未禁止娛樂。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友問：「為何要把這部平板放在社區借書櫃？」它能掃描借還紀錄。哪句最完整？

options.en: It is a practical tool rather than just a toy; volunteers can scan loans and returns with it.
options.zh: 它不只是玩具，也是實用工具；義工可以用它掃描借還紀錄。

options.en: Volunteers can scan the book records.
options.zh: 義工可以掃描圖書紀錄。

options.en: The tablet can help the lending desk.
options.zh: 平板可以幫助借書處。

dialogue.explanationZh: 金句說明裝置角色及具體用途。

speaking.en: The simple phone became a practical tool rather than just a toy on the fishing boat.
speaking.zh: 在漁船上，簡單手機不只是玩具，也是實用工具。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再說出手機完成的實際工作。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：維修隊使用小型相機記錄大廈外牆裂縫，讓工程師比較維修前後的照片；休息時它也能拍有趣的照片。用一至兩句英文解釋相機的角色。
writing.selfCheckZh: 指出相機如何支援維修紀錄；不要說娛樂用途完全消失。

examples.en: The camera is a practical tool rather than just a toy because the crew can document cracks before and after repairs.
examples.zh: 相機不只是玩具，也是實用工具，因為維修隊可以記錄維修前後的裂縫。

examples.en: It can take playful pictures, but it is a practical tool rather than just a toy for comparing repair records.
examples.zh: 它可以拍有趣的照片，但用來比較維修紀錄時，不只是玩具，也是實用工具。

takeaways.en: A radio can be a practical tool rather than just a toy when it carries weather updates.
takeaways.zh: 收音機提供天氣資訊時，不只是玩具，也是實用工具。

takeaways.en: For the repair team, the camera was a practical tool rather than just a toy.
takeaways.zh: 對維修隊而言，相機不只是玩具，也是實用工具。

notes: AI-authored provisional proposal; independent English, Chinese, media and browser QA remain pending.

brief.meaningEn: Fashions or interests that attract attention briefly and then fade.
brief.meaningZh: 短時間受注目，其後便消退的潮流或興趣。
brief.grammar: Passing modifies trends as short-lived, not as trends physically moving past.
brief.boundaryZh: 不能因新事物尚未證實長久便斷定它一定轉瞬即逝。
brief.misconceptionZh: 這片語形容潮流的持續時間，不是說所有新意念都沒有價值。
brief.outcomeZh: 能說明為何先觀察需求再決定是否長期投入。

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 10 to 16 Part 3.docx
sources.locatorNote: DOCX table 44, row 7; page refers to the locally rendered PDF recorded in the intake summary.
sources.sentence: She learned to wait before buying into passing trends.

options.en: The excitement might fade before the club used the whole set.
options.zh: 熱潮可能在學會用完整套器材前便消退。

options.en: The gadgets had already broken.
options.zh: 器材已經損壞。

options.en: Borrowing proved nobody enjoyed science.
options.zh: 借用證明沒有人喜歡科學。

options.en: Every online interest lasts for years.
options.zh: 每種網上興趣都持續多年。

listening.explanationZh: 她想先測試持續需求，避免受短暫熱潮左右。
listening.en: A science club considered buying an expensive set of gadgets after a week of online excitement. Mina suggested borrowing one first because some interests are passing trends.
listening.zh: 科學學會看到網上熱潮持續一星期，正考慮購買一套昂貴器材。米娜建議先借一件試用，因為有些興趣只是短暫流行。

options.en: She wanted to see whether interest lasted.
options.zh: 她想看看興趣能否持續。

options.en: She did not want to commit money too early.
options.zh: 她不想太早投入金錢。

options.en: She wanted to avoid spending on passing trends.
options.zh: 她想避免為短暫流行花錢。

options.en: The club could test one device before a large purchase.
options.zh: 學會可先試一件器材，再決定是否大量購買。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都指先觀察熱潮是否持續。
reply.promptEn: Why did Mina recommend borrowing first?

scene.promptZh: 校刊編輯發現某個網上話題只有兩天熱度，決定先問讀者是否真的關心，再安排專題。哪句最貼切？

options.en: The editors want to avoid treating passing trends as lasting interests.
options.zh: 編輯不想把短暫流行當成持久興趣。

options.en: Two busy days prove the topic deserves a permanent column.
options.zh: 兩天熱度便證明話題值得設立固定欄目。

options.en: They refuse to cover any new topic.
options.zh: 他們拒絕報道任何新話題。

scene.explanationZh: 先查讀者需求是審慎判斷，不是否定所有新題材。

contrast.promptZh: 哪句把 passing 誤作實際移動？

options.en: A brief craze may fade next month.
options.zh: 短暫熱潮可能下月消退。

options.en: The phrase means fashions walk past the school gate.
options.zh: 這片語表示潮流從校門口走過。

options.en: Not every new interest becomes a lasting need.
options.zh: 並非每項新興趣都成為長久需求。

contrast.explanationZh: passing 在這裏指短暫，不指實際移動。

dialogue.promptZh: 編輯問：「這個話題今早很熱，是否應把全年版面都留給它？」你只看到兩天數據。哪句最完整？

options.en: It could be one of those passing trends; let us check readers’ interest over time before reserving a full year.
options.zh: 它可能只是短暫流行之一；先觀察讀者一段時間的興趣，再預留全年版面吧。

options.en: We only have two days of data.
options.zh: 我們只有兩天數據。

options.en: Let us survey readers next week.
options.zh: 下星期先訪問讀者吧。

dialogue.explanationZh: 金句指出不確定性並提出合理觀察方法。

speaking.en: The club borrowed a device first to avoid spending heavily on passing trends.
speaking.zh: 學會先借器材，避免為短暫流行花費太多。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再說出為何先借用。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：校刊想決定下學期的長期欄目。編輯看到一個話題在社交平台熱了兩天，但尚未知道學生是否持續關心。用一至兩句英文提出編輯方法。
writing.selfCheckZh: 把短暫熱潮與持久需求分開；不要武斷說該題材必定失敗。

examples.en: The editors should not build a long-running column around passing trends without first asking what readers still care about next month.
examples.zh: 編輯未問清讀者下月是否仍關心之前，不應只憑短暫流行開設長期欄目。

examples.en: A two-day spike may reflect passing trends, so the team should survey students before choosing a permanent column.
examples.zh: 兩天的熱度可能只是短暫流行，所以團隊應在選定固定欄目前訪問學生。

takeaways.en: A shop may test demand before filling its shelves with passing trends.
takeaways.zh: 商店可先測試需求，再決定是否大量進貨迎合短暫流行。

takeaways.en: The curator watched passing trends but chose exhibits that would remain useful.
takeaways.zh: 策展人留意短暫流行，卻選擇較長久有用的展品。

notes: AI-authored provisional proposal; independent English, Chinese, media and browser QA remain pending.

brief.meaningEn: Make a line or message have a strong emotional or rhetorical impact.
brief.meaningZh: 令一句話或訊息產生強烈的情感或說服效果。
brief.grammar: Figurative boxing metaphor: the subject can be a sentence or message; no physical hit occurs.
brief.boundaryZh: 效果須由簡潔、位置或內容支持，不能只因聲量大便說有力。
brief.misconceptionZh: 不要與 pack a punch 混為完全相同的句法；本課以 line/message land a punch 為主。
brief.outcomeZh: 能說出哪句話因何時出現而產生效果。

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 10 to 16 Part 3.docx
sources.locatorNote: DOCX table 51, row 10; page refers to the locally rendered PDF recorded in the intake summary.
sources.sentence: A simple line can land a punch in the final verse.

options.en: It connected the closure to people the audience could picture.
options.zh: 它把花園關閉與聽眾能想像的人連起來。

options.en: It contained a literal boxing move.
options.zh: 它含有實際拳擊動作。

options.en: It proved the garden would reopen tomorrow.
options.zh: 它證明花園明天會重開。

options.en: It was the longest sentence in the speech.
options.zh: 它是講稿最長的一句。

listening.explanationZh: 孩子的具體形象令結尾句更有情感力量。
listening.en: At the end of a short speech about a closed community garden, the speaker named the children who had planted its first trees. That final sentence landed a punch, and the audience fell quiet.
listening.zh: 一場關於社區花園關閉的短講，講者最後提到種下第一批樹木的孩子。最後一句話產生有力效果，聽眾安靜下來。

options.en: It made the loss feel personal.
options.zh: 它令失去花園變得切身。

options.en: It gave the short speech a memorable ending.
options.zh: 它令短講有令人記住的結尾。

options.en: It landed a punch.
options.zh: 它產生了有力效果。

options.en: It made listeners pause and reflect.
options.zh: 它令聽眾停下來思考。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都描述結尾句產生衝擊；金句使用來源比喻。
reply.promptEn: What effect did the final sentence have?

scene.promptZh: 展覽文字最後只寫一句「這些信至今沒有人回覆」，令訪客停下來看失散家庭的照片。哪句最貼切？

options.en: The closing line lands a punch without being long.
options.zh: 這句結尾不長，卻產生有力效果。

options.en: The line mainly directs visitors to the next room.
options.zh: 這句話主要是指示訪客前往下一展室。

options.en: The caption is effective only because it is printed in large type.
options.zh: 文字有效只因字體很大。

scene.explanationZh: 有力來自與失散家庭相連的內容及結尾位置，不是指路或字體大小。

contrast.promptZh: 哪句是字面拳擊，並非此課修辭用法？

options.en: The final sentence changed the room’s mood.
options.zh: 最後一句改變了現場氣氛。

options.en: The boxer landed a punch on his opponent’s shoulder.
options.zh: 拳手一拳打中對手肩膀。

options.en: A short warning made readers stop.
options.zh: 簡短警告令讀者停下來。

contrast.explanationZh: 拳手實際擊中對手，屬字面動作。

dialogue.promptZh: 同事說：「報告結尾只用一句話，會不會太短？」你想用一句具體發現促請市議會維修飲水機。哪句最完整？

options.en: A clear final line can land a punch if it shows how many children lacked drinking water; keep the evidence precise.
options.zh: 若清楚說明多少孩子缺乏飲用水，結尾一句也能有力；證據要準確。

options.en: One sentence can be enough.
options.zh: 一句話也可能足夠。

options.en: We should include the number of affected children.
options.zh: 我們應列出受影響孩子的人數。

dialogue.explanationZh: 金句說明具體證據如何令簡短結尾有力。

speaking.en: The final sentence landed a punch because it named the families affected.
speaking.zh: 結尾一句提到受影響的家庭，因而產生有力效果。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再說出哪個細節令結尾有力。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：市民小組向議會提交公共飲水機維修報告，結尾以一項核實過的數字說明多少孩子要排隊取水。用一至兩句英文解釋結尾的效果。
writing.selfCheckZh: 指出核實過的人數及其可能令議員採取的行動；不要虛構確切數字或宣稱已觀察到反應。

examples.en: The report’s final line could land a punch: a verified figure shows how many children wait for water each day and may prompt council members to schedule repairs.
examples.zh: 報告的結尾一句可能產生有力效果：核實過的數字顯示每天有多少孩子要排隊取水，或會促使議員安排維修。

examples.en: A short closing sentence can land a punch when a verified count of children who wait for water each day gives council members a reason to act.
examples.zh: 簡短的結尾若指出每天等候取水的孩子人數，而且數字經過核實，便可能產生有力效果，給議員採取行動的理由。

takeaways.en: A precise final line can land a punch without shouting.
takeaways.zh: 準確的結尾一句毋須吶喊也能產生有力效果。

takeaways.en: The warning landed a punch after the audience saw the empty reservoir.
takeaways.zh: 聽眾看到空水庫後，警告產生了有力效果。

notes: AI-authored provisional proposal; independent English, Chinese, media and browser QA remain pending.

brief.meaningEn: A useful specialised place alongside more common alternatives.
brief.meaningZh: 與較普遍的選擇並存、用途專門而有限的位置。
brief.grammar: Role is a countable noun here: a niche role in a service or alongside another option.
brief.boundaryZh: 小眾不等於無用，也不等於主要選擇。
brief.misconceptionZh: 不要因某服務有專門用途便說它適合所有人。
brief.outcomeZh: 能指出服務特別適合哪一群人或哪一種情況。

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 10 to 16 Part 3.docx
sources.locatorNote: DOCX table 54, row 10; page refers to the locally rendered PDF recorded in the intake summary.
sources.sentence: Vinyl has a niche role alongside streaming.

options.en: It served a group near the eastern pier.
options.zh: 它服務東面碼頭附近的一群居民。

options.en: It had replaced every bus on the island.
options.zh: 它取代了島上所有巴士。

options.en: No residents ever used the ferry.
options.zh: 從沒有居民乘渡輪。

options.en: It travelled faster than every other service.
options.zh: 它比所有其他交通工具都快。

listening.explanationZh: 渡輪服務特定居民，並非主要交通方式。
listening.en: Most island residents used the bridge bus, but the small ferry still served families living by the eastern pier. It kept a niche role in local transport.
listening.zh: 大多數島民乘過橋巴士，但小渡輪仍接載住在東面碼頭附近的家庭。它在本地交通中保留專門而有限的作用。

reply.promptZh: （渡輪在本地交通中有甚麼位置？）

options.en: It helped a particular group of residents.
options.zh: 它幫助一群特定居民。

options.en: It remained useful beside the bus.
options.zh: 它與巴士並存，仍有用途。

options.en: It had a niche role.
options.zh: 它有專門而有限的作用。

options.en: It was not the main route for most residents.
options.zh: 它不是大多數居民的主要路線。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都描述專門但非主流的用途。
reply.promptEn: What place did the ferry have in local transport?

scene.promptZh: 學校大多使用電子教材，但大型字體印本仍方便少數視力較弱學生。哪句最貼切？

options.en: Large-print copies have a niche role alongside digital materials.
options.zh: 大型字體印本與電子教材並存，有專門而有限的作用。

options.en: The school should replace all digital materials with large-print copies.
options.zh: 學校應以大型字體印本取代所有電子教材。

options.en: The school has stopped using digital materials.
options.zh: 學校已停止使用電子教材。

scene.explanationZh: 印本服務特定需求，不等於所有人都需改用印本。

options.en: A small service can matter to particular users.
options.zh: 小型服務對特定使用者仍可能重要。

options.en: It means the service has no users and no purpose.
options.zh: 它表示服務沒有用戶，也沒有用途。

options.en: A specialised option can coexist with a common one.
options.zh: 專門選擇可與普遍選擇並存。

contrast.explanationZh: 小眾並不代表毫無用途。

dialogue.promptZh: 居民問：「既然大多數人乘巴士，為何仍保留渡輪？」你知道東面碼頭附近家庭靠它接駁。哪句最完整？

options.en: The ferry has a niche role: it serves families near the eastern pier even though most residents use the bus.
options.zh: 渡輪有專門而有限的作用：雖然大多數居民乘巴士，它仍服務東面碼頭附近的家庭。

options.en: Some families still use the ferry.
options.zh: 有些家庭仍乘渡輪。

options.en: The bus carries most island residents.
options.zh: 巴士接載大多數島民。

dialogue.explanationZh: 金句同時指出特定用戶與主流替代方式。

speaking.en: The ferry kept a niche role for families near the eastern pier.
speaking.zh: 渡輪為東面碼頭附近的家庭保留專門而有限的作用。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再說出它服務哪一群人。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：大部分樂器店只賣新品，但一家小店專修舊木管樂器，服務少數仍使用這些樂器的樂手。用一至兩句英文解釋為何它仍有價值。
writing.selfCheckZh: 指出專門服務及其用戶；不要說它取代所有樂器店。

examples.en: The repair shop has a niche role because it helps musicians keep older woodwind instruments in use.
examples.zh: 維修店有專門而有限的作用，因為它協助樂手繼續使用舊木管樂器。

examples.en: New-instrument stores serve most buyers, but this small workshop retains a niche role for players with older woodwinds.
examples.zh: 新品樂器店服務大多數買家，但這間小工作坊對使用舊木管樂器的樂手仍有專門作用。

takeaways.en: A specialist repair shop can have a niche role beside large stores.
takeaways.zh: 專門維修店可與大型商店並存，發揮專門而有限的作用。

takeaways.en: Printed maps retain a niche role for visitors without reliable phone access.
takeaways.zh: 對無法穩定使用手機的訪客，印刷地圖仍有專門而有限的作用。

notes: AI-authored provisional proposal; independent English, Chinese, media and browser QA remain pending.

lessons.titleEn: the body was made to move

brief.meaningEn: An encouraging way to say movement belongs in everyday life.
brief.meaningZh: 鼓勵人在日常生活中按能力活動的自然說法。
brief.grammar: A memorable general statement, not a literal manufacturing claim or a medical prescription.
brief.boundaryZh: 活動方式可因個人能力而異；不應暗示每人都必須做劇烈運動。
brief.misconceptionZh: 這句不是任何特定運動可治病的證據。
brief.outcomeZh: 能提出適合情境、可自行調整的日常活動。

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 10 to 16 Part 3.docx
sources.locatorNote: DOCX table 186, row 2; page refers to the locally rendered PDF recorded in the intake summary.
sources.sentence: Even gentle walks remind us the body was made to move.
sources.expression: the body was made to move

options.en: People could choose a comfortable way to be active.
options.zh: 大家可以選擇舒適的活動方式。

options.en: Everyone had to run the same distance.
options.zh: 每人都必須跑相同距離。

options.en: Seated stretches did not count as movement.
options.zh: 坐着伸展不算活動。

options.en: The centre had cancelled all its programmes.
options.zh: 中心已取消所有活動。

listening.explanationZh: 她提供不同選擇，沒有要求人人做同一種運動。
listening.en: At a community centre, Mei offered seated stretches as well as short walks. She said the body was made to move and invited everyone to choose a comfortable option.
listening.zh: 社區中心裏，美安排了坐着伸展和短步行。她說身體需要活動，邀請大家選擇自己覺得舒適的方式。

options.en: People could move in a way that suited them.
options.zh: 大家可以用適合自己的方式活動。

options.en: A short walk was not the only option.
options.zh: 短步行不是唯一選擇。

options.en: She believed the body was made to move, so she offered comfortable ways to do it.
options.zh: 她認為身體需要活動，所以提供不同的舒適活動方式。

options.en: She wanted everyone to find a comfortable form of movement.
options.zh: 她想讓每人找到舒適的活動方式。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都說明為何提供不同活動選擇；金句保留本課表達。
reply.promptEn: Why did Mei offer two options?

scene.promptZh: 職員久坐後想在休息時間稍作活動；有人選擇站起來伸展，另一人選擇慢步。哪句最貼切？

options.en: The body was made to move, and each person can choose a comfortable option.
options.zh: 身體需要活動，每人也可選擇舒適方式。

options.en: The group should follow one fixed exercise plan during every break.
options.zh: 小組每次休息都應遵循同一套固定運動安排。

options.en: Only running counts as movement.
options.zh: 只有跑步才算活動。

scene.explanationZh: 句子鼓勵不同方式的活動，沒有規定小組每次都照同一套做。

contrast.promptZh: 哪句把這句話說成它並沒有提出的醫學保證？

options.en: A short movement break may feel pleasant.
options.zh: 短暫活動休息可能令人舒服。

options.en: This phrase proves a daily walk cures every illness.
options.zh: 這句話證明每天步行可治好所有疾病。

options.en: People can choose movement suited to them.
options.zh: 人們可選擇適合自己的活動。

contrast.explanationZh: 這是鼓勵活動的說法，並非醫學證明。

dialogue.promptZh: 同事說：「休息時間太短，動不了。」你知道大家可自行選擇伸展或慢步。哪句最完整？

options.en: The body was made to move; even a short stretch or slow walk can fit a break if it feels comfortable.
options.zh: 身體需要活動；若覺得舒適，短暫伸展或慢步也可安排在休息時間。

options.en: A short stretch is one option.
options.zh: 短暫伸展是一個選擇。

options.en: We have a few minutes before work resumes.
options.zh: 復工前還有幾分鐘。

dialogue.explanationZh: 金句鼓勵按能力作短暫活動，沒有作醫學保證。

speaking.en: The body was made to move, so she offered a choice of gentle activities.
speaking.zh: 身體需要活動，所以她提供不同的溫和活動選擇。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再說出有哪些可選活動。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：課堂演讀故事時，教師讓學生自由選擇站着演角色、坐着做手勢，或先觀察再加入。用一至兩句英文說明為何讀書活動可包含動作。
writing.selfCheckZh: 用這句話鼓勵按能力參與演讀，不要把活動說成治療或強迫每人站起來。

examples.en: The body was made to move, so the teacher offered standing roles and seated gestures as two ways to act out the story.
examples.zh: 身體需要活動，所以教師提供站着演角色和坐着做手勢兩種演讀方法。

examples.en: Story reading can include movement because the body was made to move; pupils choose a comfortable way to join in.
examples.zh: 演讀故事可包括動作，因為身體需要活動；學生自行選擇舒適的參與方式。

takeaways.en: The body was made to move, but the pace can differ from person to person.
takeaways.zh: 身體需要活動，但每人的步伐可以不同。

takeaways.en: A gentle stretch can remind us the body was made to move.
takeaways.zh: 溫和伸展可以提醒我們身體需要活動。

notes: AI-authored provisional proposal; independent English, Chinese, media and browser QA remain pending.
